## Important info

This skin doesn't interfere with any other Ahri skin, so you can keep it on and use other skins without any changes made to them.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Foxfire Ahri

**Affects**: Textures, VFX

Changed the tails' textures so they aren't made out of cheetos. Also changed the tail glow when you cast Q or W from blue to orange.
